why: The major reviewers here don't answer the question. Macworld's car picks are 15W and uncooled, and WIRED's tested cooling pick is a bedside stand. The rest are niche or affiliate pages (mobileplustech, The Gadgeteer, ChargeTechLab) plus the same recycled text on rottenwifi, sekin and carcody. They rely on maker specs and Anker's own "50% in 22 minutes" claim, and some say outright that they never used the products. A focused page with checkable temperatures and sustained-watt numbers, prices and a direct pick would stand out.
